note: Curated regulatory / market events for the client roster brands, powering the home-screen ticker. Editorial and approximate (through the ~2026-01 knowledge cutoff) -- these are illustrative, NOT a live FDA feed; validate dates against FDA.gov / press releases before external use. Live KB-derived items (newest trials/labels) are merged in at runtime by strategy/feed.py. Types: approval | launch | indication_change | notice | label_update.

events.headline: Fabhalta (iptacopan) gains C3 glomerulopathy indication
events.detail: Label expanded beyond PNH and IgA nephropathy into C3G.

events.headline: Monjuvi (tafasitamab) approved in relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma
events.detail: inMIND-based expansion into FL alongside DLBCL.

events.headline: Lynkuet (elinzanetant) approved for menopausal vasomotor symptoms
events.detail: Non-hormonal NK-1/NK-3 receptor antagonist enters the VMS market.

events.headline: Pluvicto (lutetium) moves pre-taxane in PSMA+ mCRPC
events.detail: PSMAfore-based label expands the treatable population earlier in the pathway.

events.headline: Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan) faces US generic entry
events.detail: First generics enter following the 2025 patent cliff; defend-phase dynamics intensify.

events.headline: Kisqali (ribociclib) NATALEE early-breast-cancer uptake accelerates
events.detail: Adjuvant HR+/HER2- stage II/III expansion drives growth.

events.headline: Niktimvo (axatilimab) available for chronic GVHD (3L+)
events.detail: First anti-CSF-1R approval in chronic graft-versus-host disease.

events.headline: Eylea HD (aflibercept 8 mg) extended dosing intervals updated
events.detail: Defence against 2 mg biosimilar erosion leans on HD switching.

events.headline: Padcev (enfortumab vedotin) + pembrolizumab entrenched as 1L urothelial SoC
events.detail: First-line locally advanced/metastatic urothelial cancer standard of care.

events.headline: Ibrance (palbociclib) navigates CDK4/6 competition ahead of LOE
events.detail: Share pressure from newer CDK4/6 agents as loss-of-exclusivity approaches.

events.headline: Iqirvo (elafibranor) launches in primary biliary cholangitis
events.detail: First-in-class PPAR agonist for PBC as 2L or monotherapy.
